style: Pop art in the style of Roy Lichtenstein or Andy Warhol. Ben-Day halftone dots visible in skin tones and backgrounds. Heavy black outlines. Flat areas of vivid primary colors (red, yellow, blue) and pink. High contrast, punchy, commercial look. The image should look like it was screen-printed — slightly misregistered ink layers, bold graphic impact. NOT subtle — everything is cranked to maximum saturation.

scene.activity: Mumford and Fennec are diligently tending to their vibrant patio garden, with Mumford carefully watering a pot of blooming tulips using a brightly colored watering can, while Fennec, wrapped in a graphic scarf against the gentle breeze, proudly admires a cluster of yellow daffodils.

style: Stained glass cathedral window. Every shape outlined by thick black leading (1-3 pixels wide) separating segments of pure saturated jewel-toned glass — deep ruby red, sapphire blue, emerald green, amber yellow. No gradients within segments; each piece of glass is a single flat color. Light appears to glow through from behind, making colors luminous. Backgrounds broken into decorative geometric glass panes. Figures have the simplified iconic quality of medieval church windows. Should look like you could reach out and feel the cold lead came.

scene.activity: Mumford, with his warm buff coat rendered in amber and cream glass segments, is serenely enjoying the gentle breeze from a sturdy porch swing, his golden-green eyes simplified into emerald ovals as he attempts to read from a book, while Fennec, his wrinkly gray/lavender skin depicted in cool sapphire and amethyst glass panes, is cozily bundled in a light throw blanket of deep ruby red glass segments, happily sipping from a small, vibrant emerald green mug, occasionally casting a simplified pale blue eye towards the swaying, newly leafed branches.

style: Bauhaus / Constructivist poster in the style of Rodchenko, El Lissitzky, or Herbert Bayer. Bold geometric composition built from pure circles, rectangles, and diagonals. Strictly primary palette — saturated red, pure blue, pure yellow, plus black and white. No gradients, no textures — flat graphic shapes only. Strong diagonal tension, shapes stacked and overlapping at angles. Sans-serif geometric typography integrated as part of the composition. Revolutionary, functional, machine-age — looks like a 1920s agitprop poster or a Bauhaus exhibition flyer.

scene.activity: Margot, embodying geometric precision, is enthusiastically demonstrating the assembly of a new, vibrantly colored modular birdhouse, constructed from stark red, blue, and yellow planar shapes, while Zeya, her single black circular eye keenly focused, meticulously aligns a small yellow triangular piece with her paw, and Pebble dozes contentedly, a large blue geometric shape indicating her relaxed posture, against a simplified white rectangular bench.

style: Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print in the tradition of Hokusai or Hiroshige. Flat planes of pure color with no shading or gradients. Strong, confident black outlines drawn as if carved from a woodblock — slightly varying in thickness. Limited palette of deep Prussian blue, vermilion red, warm yellow, leafy green, and black on a cream/off-white paper ground. Stylized waves, clouds, and plants rendered as decorative patterns. The image should look like it was hand-pressed from carved cherrywood blocks — visible paper texture, occasional slight ink unevenness.

scene.activity: Mumford and Fennec sit at a small tea table beneath blooming crabapple branches, with Mumford politely pouring iced tea while Fennec, in a tiny dark collar charm, reaches for a plate of snacks and inspects a paper weather slip like a little host.

style: Papercut silhouette art in the tradition of Chinese jianzhi or Scherenschnitte. Single color cut from paper and laid over a contrasting background — typically bold red silhouettes on white, or black silhouettes on a single color. Shapes defined entirely by outline — every detail, including eyes and whiskers, is a cut-out void or a delicate connecting bridge of paper. Intricate lacework patterns and decorative borders. No shading, no colors within silhouettes — pure figure-ground contrast. Should look like scissors-cut paper craft, not digital vector art.

scene.activity: On a breezy spring porch, Pebble leans over a tiny woven basket to hold down a paper kite tail while Mumford, beside her in a little chair, studies a folded weather newspaper and points up at the sky like they are planning a perfect afternoon outing together.

style: Memphis Group postmodern design from 1980s Milan (Ettore Sottsass, Nathalie Du Pasquier). Bold primary colors — red, blue, yellow, green — plus black and white. Playful geometric patterns: squiggles, dots, zigzags, triangles, and "bacterio" speckles used as decorative fills. Flat shapes with no shading, arranged with deliberate asymmetric imbalance. Black-and-white patterns (checkerboards, squiggle grids) used as backgrounds or on furniture. Feels brash, cheerful, and off-kilter — like an album cover from 1985 or a set from Pee-wee's Playhouse.

scene.activity: Zeya is enthusiastically chasing and dropping a neon-red ball to host fetch, while Patrick, Pixel, and Kona lounge at a geometric patio café table sharing cool drinks, with Patrick reading the forecast card, Pixel pointing at the sky, and Kona leaning in for cuddles beside him.

style: 1930s-1950s vintage travel poster. Flat areas of color with no gradients, strong geometric composition, dramatic perspective. Warm palette of dusty blues, sunset oranges, cream, and forest green. Bold sans-serif typography integrated into the design. The image should look like a lithograph print — slightly grainy texture, visible ink layers, muted rather than bright colors.

scene.activity: Margot, Zeya, Pebble, Mumford, Fennec, Patrick, Pixel, and Kona are gathered as a tiny pet meteorology lab team, all facing the camera in different little lab badges while they celebrate Test Day around a miniature weather station and a big "Happy Test Day" sign.

style: Abstract organic cut-paper style. Loose, energetic brushstrokes in primary colors (red, blue, yellow, green, black) on a white or cream background. Thick black outlines that look hand-drawn with a marker. Shapes are free-form and imprecise — leaves, flowers, and figures are suggested rather than detailed. Joyful, spontaneous, and childlike but sophisticated.

scene.activity: At a tiny outdoor weather lab table, Margot, Zeya, Pebble, Mumford, Fennec, Patrick, Pixel, and Kona all face the camera in matching-but-different little lab badges while they celebrate Happy Test Day around a miniature weather station, confetti, clipboards, and a big sign, with Margot playfully nudging Zeya, Pebble leaning in for a cozy group pose, and the cats tucked right into the cheerful bustle.

style: Street art stencil on a concrete or brick wall. Crisp stencil-cut shapes with sharp edges and visible spray paint overspray halos. The wall texture (aggregate, mortar lines, weathered paint) shows through the ink. Limited to 3-4 spray paint colors — black, white, red, and blue. Occasional drips and runs where the paint pooled. Bold graphic silhouettes with flat color fills. NOT a cartoon about graffiti — the IMAGE ITSELF should look like it IS spray-painted on a wall.

scene.activity: On a windy mid-spring courtyard, Margot, Zeya, Pebble, Mumford, Patrick, Pixel, and Kona gather around Fennec’s birthday blanket-nest while Fennec, crowned as the birthday star, sits in a warm little throne of folded blankets receiving treats, with Margot teasingly presenting a frisbee-shaped gift and the cats joining the celebration like a cozy audience.

Thick black outlines that look hand-drawn with a marker. Shapes are free-form and imprecise — leaves, flowers, and figures are suggested rather than detailed. Joyful, spontaneous, and childlike but sophisticated.

scene.activity: On an overcast summer afternoon, Mumford and Fennec run a tiny lemonade-and-ice-pops stand in the yard, with Mumford arranging bright cups and Fennec in a sweater-sleeve apron fussing over the cooler and sniffing the snacks like a food critic.
scene.weather_integration: Show the forecast in the scene through a pale gray cloud-shaped pennant hanging from the lemonade stand awning, with tiny simple icon marks worked into the cloth pattern and a few wind-swept napkins fluttering sideways to suggest the 11 mph breeze and dry, overcast conditions.

The image should read as a lithograph print — slightly grainy texture, visible ink layers, muted rather than bright colors.

scene.activity: On a breezy overcast summer afternoon in La Crosse, Pebble and Mumford operate a cozy porch-side welcome-mat weaving station, with Pebble carefully pressing strips into a bold geometric pattern while Mumford sorts the colors and coils the finished mat beside him.
scene.weather_integration: Integrate the weather into the mat design itself: the woven pattern includes a pale overcast cloud band, a small angled wind-chevron motif to suggest the 11 mph breeze, and a few tiny dry-grass blocks in the lawn; the mat’s label tag can read as a stylized travel-poster stamp rather than explicit forecast text.
